content:
200 Returned if the list of product pages is retrieved successfully.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Array [
string
The name of the product.
string
Product page slug, for example, nessus .
string
The description of a product.
string
The URL to list the product files available for download.
]
500 Returned if an internal error occurred while processing the request.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
title
page_slug
description
files_index_url
boolean
Indicates whether the server successfully processed the request or not.
integer
The HTTP response status code of request.
string
The error that corresponds to the HTTP response status code.
string
Additional details about the error.
object
